This is not merely an internal restructuring of Anker's brand architecture, but a move to significantly reduce consumers' cognitive burden—users will only need to recognize one Anker for a seamless intelligent experience across their entire journey. En el acto de precalentamiento de la feria, el director ejecutivo de la IFA, Leif Lindner, anticipó que la IA impregnará la esencia de la edición de este año. Señaló que en años anteriores la IFA contaba con una zona de exposición de IA independiente para albergar a las empresas y productos relacionados; pero hoy en día, la IA ha pasado de ser una categoría segmentada a convertirse en la infraestructura que sustenta toda la industria de la electrónica de consumo, integrándose en casi todas las categorías.

items.raw_excerpt: 多数屏显 AI 眼镜，总要在重量、外观、音频体验之间做出取舍。 加南全新研发的带显示 AI 眼镜，把 26g 无感佩戴、无边框形态与内置扬声器融为一体。智能显示不再是显眼的科技装置，而是回归一副日常眼镜的模样。 AI 眼镜，应当首先是一副适合日常佩戴的眼镜。 自 K2 开始，加南始终坚持，智能眼镜不该是笨重的科技外设。它需要拥有普通眼镜的佩戴体验，能够陪伴用户完整的日常生活。今天，我们带来正在推进的全新带显示 AI 眼镜研发预告，将对全天候智能佩戴的思考，融入一副接近传统眼镜的产品形态。 全新产品采用创新无边框框型设计，脱离行业常规的金属边框方案。去掉厚重前框结构，外观高度贴近普通光学眼镜，支持近视配镜。无论是通勤出行还是办公室工作，都可以自然佩戴，消解智能硬件的突兀感。为实现这套形态，我们协同浙江通达光学有限公司，完成结构强度与量产可行性的多重验证，把设计构想落地为可量产的产品方案。 整机重量控制在 26g。 过重压鼻、久戴酸胀，是屏显类智能眼镜普遍存在的痛点。我们把整机重量做到接近普通眼镜水准，大幅降低面部佩戴负担，实现全天候长时间舒适佩戴。 设备内置扬声器单元。作为带显示 AI 眼镜，无需额外搭配耳机，音频播放、语音交互、系统提示均可由眼镜直接发声输出，在获取声音信息的同时保留对外界环境的感知，屏显视听一体化，体验更完整。 镜腿厚度做到 2.3 毫米，控制在 2.5 毫米以内。 这是目前行业内极窄的镜腿规格。极致收窄的镜腿，不止是外观上的精简，更让这副眼镜在视觉上和普通眼镜几乎没有区别，佩戴之后不会产生强烈的设备感。 搭载 PPG 心率检测模块，持续采集心跳数据。系统记录心率变化，基于心率波动感知用户状态，将情绪状态以表情包形式呈现在眼镜显示区域。同时眼镜可以主动感知用户状态，给出 AI 提示。当监测到心率出现紧急异常状况，设备将触发急救相关机制，提供安全防护。 采用

excerpt_i18n.en: Most display-equipped AI glasses require trade-offs among weight, appearance, and audio experience. Jianan's newly developed display-integrated AI glasses combine 26g barely-there wear, a frameless form, and built-in speakers in one design. Smart displays are no longer conspicuous tech gadgets but return to the look of everyday eyewear. AI glasses should first and foremost be glasses suitable for daily wear. Since the K2, Jianan has insisted that smart glasses should not be bulky tech accessories—they need the wearing experience of ordinary glasses and the ability to accompany users throughout their daily lives. Today, we bring you a preview of our new display-integrated AI glasses currently in development, incorporating our thinking on all-day smart wear into a product form close to traditional eyewear. The new product adopts an innovative frameless frame design, departing from the industry-standard metal-frame approach. By removing the heavy front-frame structure, its appearance closely resembles ordinary optical glasses and supports prescription lenses. Whether commuting or working in the office, they can be worn naturally, dissolving the obtrusiveness of smart hardware. To realize this form, we collaborated with Zhejiang Tongda Optical Co., Ltd., completing multiple rounds of validation on structural strength and mass-production feasibility, turning the design concept into a manufacturable product plan. Total device weight is controlled at 26g. Excessive weight pressing on the nose and soreness after prolonged wear are common pain points in display smart glasses. We have brought the total weight close to that of ordinary glasses, greatly reducing facial burden and enabling all-day, long-duration comfortable wear. The device has built-in speaker units.
